title: Sancti Magistar
extract:
The Sancti Magistar is the Syndicate variant of the  Magistar, available from  New Loka. It has the unique ability to heal the wielder and nearby allies when connecting with a heavy attack, and also gives a chance to resist status effects when it is wielded.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Using Heavy Attack permanently grants all attacks from Sancti Magistar 5% Life Steal, plus an additional 5% Life Steal per combo level. Healing is shared with all allies within 15 meters for the rest of the mission .
When held, the wielder receives 20% chance to resist a Status Effect.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Shattering Storm and  Crashing Havoc (Conclave only) stance.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
The Sancti Magistar can be acquired by reaching the Rank of Flawless with  New Loka and purchasing from its offerings with  125,000. As with all Syndicate weapon offerings, the Sancti Magistar is not included as a free offering option for reaching its respective access rank.
Syndicate weapons can also be acquired by trading with other players. Note that in order to be tradable, a weapon must be unranked, unused, with no Forma or Orokin Catalyst installed.
Players must reach Mastery Rank 8 or higher to acquire the Sancti Magistar, either by trading or through the Syndicates themselves.

Notes
Executing an Heavy Attack permanently' grants all attacks from Sancti Magistar 5% Life Steal, plus an additional 5% Life Steal per combo level, for a maximum of 60% Life Steal. Healing is shared with all allies within 15 meters for the rest of the mission .
Affected allies includes all Warframes, Companions, Eidolon Lures, summoned allied units such as Specters, allied Invasion units, Hostages, Kavor Defectors, Sortie and Arbitrations Defense Operatives, and Defense Objects.
Defense Objects will only be heal up to 500 health over 5 seconds which does not stack with similar restoration effects.
On Defense Objects  Sancti Magistar healing will bypass the restriction that prevent any restorative effects if their normal  Health Regeneration is paused .
When wielded, the Sancti Magistar gives a 20% chance to resist most Status Effects.
Does not include  Impact,  Void,  Knockdown,  Lifted,  Ragdoll,  Stagger, or  Stun. Includes  Microwave.

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Magistar Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Magistar with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Magistar Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Dracroot, and 150  Aggristone.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 6x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 180 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Trivia
The concept for the healing effect of the Sancti Magistar was designed by player (PS4)Sreza and the Design Council.
Prior to Update 26.0 (2019-10-31)'s removal of Channeling and charged attacks, unchanneled charge attacks with the Sancti Magistar, regardless of mods or crits, used to always be capped off at 200 health per enemy hit. Channeling allowed you to heal beyond that cap.

Bugs
Healing pulse occasionally does not take critical damage and combo counter into account.
